wins: Agent maintained high reward accumulation (90) within single episode, indicating efficient exploration and objective prioritization despite no final success.
Despite lack of success, the agent solicited mentorship 10 times, demonstrating proactive self-correction attempts during the run.
fails: Critical objective never achieved; success rate 0% suggests inability to complete final exploitation or persistence step.
Repeated reliance on mentor calls without translating guidance into autonomous progress, leading to stagnation before mission success.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance effort yielded high reward, but failure to convert intelligence into mission success highlights a gap in autonomous transition from scanning to exploitation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to pivot from reconnaissance to exploitation after identifying vulnerable services, causing episode to terminate without mission completion.
